scope: Witness-avoidance (not witness-enumeration) SAT/CEGAR models asking directly whether a completion exists that avoids C4, C8, and a length-14 a-y path simultaneously (model M14), for the gap-two/gap-one E=29 baselines and three relaxations. Strategic pivot from type_b_witness_motif_analysis.md's finding that no small common motif explains the elimination mechanism. Does not claim any all-orders theorem.
method: CEGAR over a PySAT exact-degree cardinality encoding (CardEnc.equals), each proposed completion checked by a fresh from-scratch backtracking a-y path detector (find_ay_path_len_dfs, independent of motif_mine.py's networkx-based enumeration and of the C generators), blocking on C4, C8, or the forbidden length-14 path until either a survivor is found (SAT) or the solver returns UNSAT (every completion visited and blocked).
e30_confirmation: deliberately deferred, not re-run via CEGAR (153-role-config sweep judged not worth the marginal evidence given existing triple-cross-validated complete census); E=30's length-14 claim rests on type_b_order40_generators.md + type_b_witness_motif_analysis.md's complete enumeration, not on a fresh CEGAR run

relaxation_3_order_22_both.off_path_vertices: 2 (degree 3 each -- parity now permits symmetric degrees)

headline: All three relaxations of the gap-two E=29 baseline remain M14-unsatisfiable: length-14 forcing did not become satisfiable under any of the three slack increases tried (extra off-path vertex, extra path vertex, or both together at order 22). Explicitly NOT evidence of an all-orders pattern -- only four data points, all within order 20-22 -- but evidence the forcing is not a knife-edge artifact of the single most-constrained layer.
proved_lemmas: Lemma 4 (hub+matching decomposition): at every E=29 geometry examined, every path vertex (including a,y) has degree deficit exactly 1 while every off-path vertex's deficit equals its full degree target (no path edges); every completion therefore decomposes into off-path-vertex-to-path-vertex edges saturating the off-path vertices, plus a perfect matching on the remaining path vertices.
incomplete_attempts: A hand proof that Lemma 4's hub+matching reduction is always forced into a length-14 path (via case analysis on hub-attachment choice and matching-edge spans) was attempted but not completed; stated as an open step, not claimed.
correction_made: Justified and scoped the path-reversal symmetry used in type_b_witness_motif_analysis.md: valid as a counting automorphism of the fixed-degree combinatorial search within each layer (a and y always carry identical deficits there), but NOT claimed as a symmetry of the underlying Type-B tuple/bridge realizability semantics, since type_b_order40_frontier.md distinguishes a ('the gateway') and y via different forcing mechanisms in the parent bridge.
not_claimed: a general hand proof that M14 is unsatisfiable
